practicalProcessAcceptedByA: Before another brand performance, write the verified project question, one actual observation/decision, reader action, and evidence source. Give informational content the lead and the character an expressive supporting role.

Cast moving parts and static content before tuning timing. Require a cause for each sequence: antenna notices, gaze finds the subject, consideration precedes invitation. The project text and destination stay visible and usable.

Compare full-size scenes at the smallest intended application, including first viewport and scrolled stage. A cropped stage proof cannot alone approve the landing experience, and a contact sheet cannot judge normal-speed rhythm.
Retain still-first finite playback and inspect the repeat-visit case. Immediate keyboard control feedback and purposeful keyboard-triggered content are separate lanes.

When a new comparative exploration is explicitly requested, name the axis, keep realistic identical content and give the owner functioning alternatives. Controlled microvariations are legitimate when their narrow question is explicit; never inflate them into three unrelated directions just to satisfy a template.
Tag owner preference, expert craft, browser operation, physical-device experience and unprimed human response separately. Every claim carries its source version and actual inspected evidence.

Use the pair process to challenge where a skill rule applies. The adopted capability-based hover, coarse-pointer input text, immediate focused-control feedback and truthful reduced-motion labels are concrete improvements, not a checklist replacement for brand judgment.
